title: Peanut Butter Fudge with Chopped Peanuts
summary: Creamy peanut butter fudge set with white chocolate and condensed milk, finished with a scattering of chopped roasted peanuts.

ingredients.note: check the label; most contain soya lecithin

steps.title: Prepare the tin
steps.text: Brush the tin with a little oil and line it with baking paper, leaving an overhang on two sides to use as handles.

steps.title: Melt the base
steps.text: Put the condensed milk and white chocolate in the saucepan over low heat and stir without stopping for 4-5 min, until the chocolate has only just melted and the mixture is smooth. White chocolate scorches easily, so keep the heat low.

steps.title: Add the peanut butter
steps.text: Take the pan off the heat and beat in the peanut butter and vanilla until the colour is even and the mixture is thick and fudgy.

steps.title: Add the topping
steps.text: Spread the fudge in the tin and smooth the top, then scatter the chopped peanuts over and press them in lightly so they stay put.

steps.title: Set and cut
steps.text: Refrigerate for at least 4 h, until the centre is firm. Lift the fudge out with the paper and cut into 36 squares.

tips: A common mistake is using natural peanut butter that separates; the oil can leak out and the fudge stays soft, so use a smooth, stabilised one.
If the mixture turns thick and grainy before the peanut butter goes in, the white chocolate has overheated; start again over lower heat.
Cut with a knife dipped in hot water and dried for clean edges.
For a deeper flavour, toast the chopped peanuts in a dry pan for 2-3 min and cool before scattering.
storage: Keep in an airtight box in the fridge for up to 2 weeks, or freeze for up to 2 months. Serve slightly chilled.
